bibl.title: On cubic and other volumetric cubits and fingers
bibl.seg: Julia Lougovaya, On Cubic and Other Volumetric Cubits and Fingers.
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 1 (2022) §1-42, figg.
bibl.note: 1. A "regular" cubit and its subunits. - 2. The 2-palm solid cubit of Paul Tannery. - 3. A 3-palm solid cubit. - 4. P. Harris I, 50 (= MP3 2321; LDAB 5207) and χυδαῖοι δάκτυλοι. - 5. Ptolemaic, Nicomedian, and solid cubits in P. Oxy. XLIX, 3455 (= MP3 2337.1; LDAB 5560) and mensuration of wood. - Conclusion. - On the basis of the evidence from a metrological treatise of Didymus and from P. Math. (= LDAB 10719), this paper identifies other papyrological attestations of these cubits and associates their use with mensuration of wood and timber.
